engine_url.description: Host name of your ContextRail engine only: no https://, no path, no port. The app always calls it over HTTPS.

regex.engine-host-error: Enter the engine host only, e.g. contextrail.example.com (no https://, path or port).

engine_token.description: The engine's ENGINE_TOKEN. Stored encrypted by Freshworks and sent only in the Authorization header of the app's request templates; the app's code never reads it.

regex.engine-token-error: The engine token must be at least 16 characters with no spaces.
